In the next/prev case, it should show the drawer container, structure, drawer header, and footer as static and the inner content as dynamic, with the inner content stretching with flex grow between the header and the footer and establishing min-h-0 and flex-grow and overflow hidden, and then should show how the dynamic inner content slots into that static structure, and how the inner content that is dynamic can show empty messages or loading indicators that are centered in the available height because of the flex grow and overflow hidden, but then list-style content that is dynamic can define max-h-0 and overflow-y-auto to force scroll.  the footer should have the next and previous buttons which are static, and it should emphasis that we don't unmount/remount 3 different drawers on each tab or prev/next change - the goal of everything we do in teh UI is to hold contsant what is static and unchanging, maximize that structure and minimize the dynamic.  the tabs case should be similar, but just doesn't have the footer at the bottom, and the tabs are static and at the top with the flex grow applied to the available space under it.
